financial_base.basis: Earnings-per-share reference consistent with the reported P/E (price / P/E), NOT an SEC-filing EPS figure
financial_base.period: Reference basis aligned with Yahoo Finance reported P/E of 30.65x on the 2026-11-24 close
financial_base.normalization_note: ADI reports FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS of $4.56 and net income of $2,267M (stockanalysis.com). Price $312.95 / EPS $4.56 implies ~68.6x, which does NOT match the Yahoo Finance reported P/E of 30.65x. The reported P/E therefore appears to be forward/TTM on a different (recovered) earnings base (~$10.21/share = $312.95 / 30.65). I use $10.21/share as the per-share earnings reference solely so the model's entry multiple equals the reported 30.65x. This is a derived reference, not a filed EPS, and the FY2025 EPS of $4.56 is treated as a depressed/cyclical trough, not the earnings power the market is pricing. Shares outstanding and FCF/share are not available from the supplied data, so a verified P/FCF cannot be computed; FCF figures are used only qualitatively (FY2025 $4,279M; TTM $5,453M; net debt negative ~$5.3-6.2B). Dividend FY2026 $4.40/share (~1.41% yield) is taken from the user-provided data.
